video_title: ‘The Wizards will be a TOP-6 SEED’ ‼️ Perk is ALL IN on Trae Young, AD & AJ Dybantsa 🔥 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins predicts the Washington Wizards will be a top-six seed
quotes.excerpt: The Wizards are making the playoffs and they're going to be a top six seed
quotes.quote: First of all, the Wizards are making the playoffs and they're going to be a top six seed in the Eastern Conference. They're going to be one of the best offensive teams in the entire league, and AJ Dybantsa is going to have zero pressure because you're playing alongside two elite prolific scorers in Anthony Davis and Trae Young, who are going to put you in position to be successful. Night in and night out, he's not going to be having to worry about the best defender on the other team guarding him. When he's put in that position, he's going to be able to flourish.

quotes.speaker: Zach Lowe
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Lowe questions the Washington Wizards' ability to win games consistently
quotes.excerpt: Does the group as a collective whole know how to win games consistently?

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Lowe
text_blocks.text: I looked this up before the show. The 10th seed last year was Miami, they won 43 games. That would mean Washington would need a 26-game win improvement to be in that 10th hole. I think they're one of 11 teams that are competing for the top eight. My concern with the Wizards, and this is not an indictment on Trae Young or Anthony Davis because both players have won elsewhere, does the group as a collective whole know how to win games consistently?

quotes.speaker: Zach Lowe
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Lowe evaluates Darryn Peterson as a gifted two-way player
quotes.excerpt: I think he's the most gifted and I think he's the most complete two-way player out there
quotes.quote: I think he's the most gifted and I think he's the most complete two-way player out there. I think certainly defensively he's going to be something that sticks out. I think the one thing that's a little bit of a concern for me is he's one for eight from three so far. Consistency from there, I think, is the one thing that I would be watching out for him.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins expects Darius Acuff Jr. to contend for Rookie of the Year
quotes.excerpt: He's going to be in the conversation for rookie of the year
quotes.quote: That he's league ready. He's ready to take this franchise and put it on his shoulders. That don't mean that they're going to be good, but he's going to have individual numbers that's going to be on the all-rookie team. He's going to be in the conversation for rookie of the year. And I remember in Summer League, everybody was in my mentions because Acuff was struggling, but he is ready and he's going to be ready.

quotes.speaker: Zach Lowe
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Lowe praises Cam Boozer's passing ability as a big man
quotes.excerpt: I think he's one of the best passing big men in the NBA right now
quotes.quote: What impressed me is what was similar when he was at Duke, his passing. Three to one assist to turnover ratio. I think he's only a rookie, but I think he's one of the best passing big men in the NBA right now. And this is a team that's loaded with bigs when you have Isaiah Stewart, Jeremy Grant, you've got Quinton Post, Zach Edey here.
